title: "DtMF" Extends All-Time Hot Latin Songs Record to 58 Consecutive Weeks at No. 1; Barcelona Public On-Sale Sells Out
detail: The Billboard Hot Latin Songs chart dated May 9, 2026 confirms "DtMF" at No. 1 for its 58th consecutive week — further extending Bad Bunny's own all-time record after surpassing Luis Fonsi & Daddy Yankee's "Despacito" (56 weeks) on April 29. The song, which first topped the chart on January 25, 2025, continues its uninterrupted reign with no competitive challenger in sight as the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour's European leg approaches. On the same day, general public tickets for Bad Bunny's two sold-out Barcelona shows (May 22–23 at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys) went on sale at 12:00 PM local time via LiveNation.es, quickly confirming what the presale had indicated: both nights are at capacity. The European leg — which continues to Lisbon (May 26–27, Estádio da Luz) and Madrid (June 4–5, Estadio Santiago Bernabéu) — represents Bad Bunny's first-ever European stadium run and the culmination of the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour.
